market_context: The Nasdaq-100 rose 1.29% to 29,651.44 (QQQ +1.27% to $721.25) as chips extended Monday’s Anthropic bounce: Bank of America, Blackstone, Citi and Morgan Stanley lined up $63B to finance Broadcom AI gear for Anthropic, AMD deepened its Meta AI partnership, and investors looked ahead to the Fed decision and megacap earnings.
market_cap_basis: Shares outstanding x 2026-10-27 close. Shares implied from Nasdaq market caps as of the 2026-10-05 close (watchlist market_cap_usd / 2026-10-05 close), so multi-class companies (e.g. GOOGL) reflect all share classes.

stocks.name: Western Digital Corporation Common Stock
stocks.reason: Follow-through on Western Digital’s Oct 22 fiscal Q1 beat and bullish Q2 guide (about $5.1B revenue / $5.80 EPS), with Zacks lifting the stock to Rank #2 (Buy) as AI/hyperscale HDD demand and rising price-per-terabyte kept storage names in the lead of Tuesday’s chip rally.

sources.title: WD Reports Fiscal First Quarter 2027 Financial Results
